name: AU Hawk
summary: A smoother arched glasshouse and lower front pane replace the old high, forward side glass. Raised arch cuts now sample the original rounded section at their actual height, removing the old shelves. Nose/tail corners are curved before lamp clipping; the bumper slot and rear lamps are rounded. Side glass clips exactly to substrate triangles; continuous door seams and body-colour moulding replace fragmented marks. LOD0 wheels have a recessed barrel and five spokes; glass is neutral grey. Coarse tiers retain their rear paint-to-glass transition. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2308 / 900 / 590 against 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. The deliberate no-wing base-sedan interpretation still differs from the sheet. LOD0 side silhouette IoU regresses from 0.9617 to 0.9559; LOD2 side-glass overlap regresses from 0.5551 to 0.5365. Thick dark window trim and plain distant rim discs remain stylised.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Unchanged generated reference sheets. Each comparison shows reference, revised render and silhouette diff through frozen shared perspective cameras (50m front/rear, 10m side/top, horizontal optical axis). Before/after and local reference contours/lamp envelopes are recorded in validation.md. Generated views are not calibrated photographs; measured regressions are disclosed.
